The image displays a line chart titled "Figure 3: Theoretical packing densities for different BNSL phases," plotting packing density (y-axis, ranging from 0.3 to 0.8) against size ratio (x-axis, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0). Seven distinct BNSL phases are represented by colored lines, each labeled in a legend on the right:

- Green: NaCl
- Magenta: AlB₂
- Teal: MgZn₂
- Blue: AuCu₃
- Red: CaCu₅
- Orange: C₆₀K₆
- Cyan: NaZn₁₃
